# ToolMart Solutions

> ToolMart Solutions is a Kenya-focused catalog of construction, building, agricultural and commercial equipment. Product listings include descriptions, specifications, prices in Kenyan shillings (KSh), images and enquiry links.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://toolmart.co.ke/): Main site and featured equipment.
- [Product catalog](https://toolmart.co.ke/products.html): Catalog across product categories.
- [Categories](https://toolmart.co.ke/categories/categories.html): Category directory.
- [Blog](https://toolmart.co.ke/blog/): Equipment guides and articles.

## Data and accuracy

- [Structured product catalog](https://toolmart.co.ke/product.json) contains product and category data.
- Product prices and availability may change; confirm them with ToolMart before relying on a listing.
- Product enquiries use the contact number published on the site: +254 720 803 295.
- [XML sitemap](https://toolmart.co.ke/sitemap.xml) lists published HTML pages.
